description: This file defines system-related constants, data structures, and types for the Mattermost server, including system identifiers, warning metrics, cryptographic keys, and system status options.

classes.name: System
classes.description: Represents a key-value pair for system settings or metrics.

classes.name: SystemPostActionCookieSecret
classes.description: Holds the secret key for post action cookies.

classes.name: SystemAsymmetricSigningKey
classes.description: Contains an ECDSA key used for asymmetric signing.

classes.name: SystemECDSAKey
classes.description: Represents an ECDSA cryptographic key with curve and coordinate components.

classes.name: ServerBusyState
classes.description: Serialization structure for server busy state information.

classes.name: AppliedMigration
classes.description: Tracks applied database migration versions and names.

classes.name: LogFilter
classes.description: Filters for log entries based on server names, log levels, and date range.

classes.name: LogEntry
classes.description: Represents a log entry with timestamp and level.

classes.name: SystemPingOptions
classes.description: Options for configuring system ping responses, including full status and REST semantics.
